title: Stanford CS25: V3 I Generalist Agents in Open-Ended Worlds
description:
October 24, 2023
Jim Fan, NVIDIA AI

Everything that moves will eventually be autonomous. In this talk, we will discuss the principles of how to build generalist agents, combine the power of LLM with low-level control, and apply them to open-ended tasks in Minecraft and robotics.

More about the course can be found here: https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs25/

View the entire CS25 Transformers United playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoROMvodv4rNiJRchCzutFw5ItR_Z27CM
